Jilong 280E Fusion Splicer – Best Price in Bangladesh (2025) | High-Performance Fiber Splicing Machine

Hot-Selling, All-Rounder Middle Trunk Line Fusion Splicer
The Jilong 280E Fusion Splicer is a high-precision, all-rounder fiber splicing machine designed for middle trunk line and FTTx networks. Its advanced splicing technology, fast operation, and lightweight design make it the perfect tool for fiber optic professionals, field technicians, and engineers.

Key Features

  • Active Clad-Alignment Technology – Ensures high-precision splicing with minimal splice loss
  • Ultra-Fast Splicing & Heating – 6-second splicing & 18-second heating for maximum efficiency
  • Lightweight & Portable Design – Weighs only 1.9kg (with battery) – Ideal for field & aerial work
  • 4.3-inch High-Resolution Color Display – 800x480 pixel screen for clear fiber viewing & operation
  • Powerful 6800mAh Battery – Supports 300+ splicing & heating cycles per charge
  • Automatic Fiber & ARC Identification – Smart technology for error-free splicing
  • Large Data Storage – Saves 10,000 splice records & 2,000 images
  • Wide Fiber Compatibility – Supports SM, MM, DS, NZDS, and G.657 fiber types
  • Durable & Rugged – Designed for harsh environments, dust-proof, and water-resistant

Jilong 280E Fusion Splicer Technical Specifications

  • Alignment Method: Active Clad-Alignment
  • Applicable Fiber Types: SM (G.652/G.657), MM (G.651), DS (G.653), NZDS (G.655)
  • Compatible Fiber/Cable: 0.25~3.0mm, Leather Cable
  • Fiber Cleave Length: 8-16mm
  • Splicing Mode: 128 programmable modes
  • Splicing Time: 6 sec. (SM G652 Quick Mode)
  • Heating Time: 18 sec. (Adjustable, Quick Mode)
  • Splice Loss: SM: 0.02dB, MM: 0.01dB, DS: 0.04dB, NZDS: 0.04dB
  • Return Loss: >60dB
  • Electrode Life: 5,000 arcs (replaceable)
  • Battery: 6800mAh, supports 300+ splicing & heating cycles per charge
  • Storage Capacity: 10,000 splice records, 2,000 images
  • Tension Test: 1.96~2.25N
  • Operating Condition: Altitude: 0~5,000m, -20°C to +50°C, Max Wind Speed: 15m/s
  • Weight: 1.6kg (without battery), 1.9kg (with battery)
  • Display: 4.3-inch high-resolution (800x480) color touchscreen
  • USB 2.0 Port – For firmware updates & data transfer


Why Choose the Jilong 280E Fusion Splicer?

  • Perfect for FTTx, FTTH, and Middle Trunk Line Networks
  • Fast & Efficient Splicing – Saves Time & Boosts Productivity
  • Lightweight & Durable – Ideal for Field & Aerial Operations
  • Designed for Harsh Environments – Built to Last
  • Best Price in Bangladesh (2025) – Unbeatable Value
